_about: The manuals an exercise sends a learner to, and how to reach them. This
file is the only place their locations are written down. Each exercise's
page is generated from it, and so is the list in exercises/README.md.
WHY LINKS AND NOT THE FILES. ST grants access to its documents 'solely
for your personal use', grants no right to sublicense to a third party,
and requires prior written permission to reproduce or distribute. A
repository handed to a client may not carry the PDFs. Size is not the
reason: all three total 8.93 MB against a 3.6 MB repository.
WHY THE LISTING PAGE AND NOT THE PDF. st.com has no per-document pages:
a document title links straight to its PDF, and revision history exists
only on the last page of the PDF itself. So the destination is the
documentation listing page, where the learner finds the row. A PDF URL
carries its revision in the filename and rots when ST republishes, and
ST's terms list 'linked to another URL' among the restricted acts.
HOW FAR A POINTER GOES. To the document, and no further. Per ADR-0003,
scaffolding may be generated and the substance a learner is sent to the
datasheet to find may not. Naming the document is scaffolding. Naming the
section, the register or the bit is the exercise. Nothing in this file
may name a chapter, a register or a value.
THE TWO LANGUAGES ARE NOT MIRRORS, and they are navigated differently.
Checked by hand in a browser on 2026-11-13, because every earlier reading
came from archived HTML and two of the four facts below were wrong:
English pages   `Search documents by title` matches the document number,
so one box and one identifier reaches any of the three.
The Nucleo page lists FORTY user manuals, so this is the
only practical route to UM1724.
Japanese page   the same box does NOT filter -- typing DS10086 or RM0368
leaves the whole list showing. But the Japanese page is
grouped into real sections by resource type, which the
English one is not, so it is navigated by section.
DS10086         the Japanese listing shows no document number at all, and
the description stays English. Identify it by the row
ending 512KB Flash/96KB RAM; the other datasheet is a
256KB part.
UM1724          absent from the Japanese Nucleo listing entirely, so the
Japanese edition sends the learner to the English page.
RM0368 EXISTS IN JAPANESE. The reference manual -- the document a learner
spends the most time in -- is offered as a Japanese translation beside the
English one, on both locales' pages. An earlier note here said the PDFs
were English in every case; that was true of the datasheet and the board
manual and false of this one.
exercises lists which exercises send a learner to this document, by
directory name, the same way divergences.json does.
